description: Add a new Contact page component with styled layout and placeholder form

userStories.title: Create Contact.jsx with Contact React component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to add a new file src/pages/Contact.jsx that exports a default functional React component rendering a styled contact page.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/pages/Contact.jsx exists and exports a default functional component named Contact
Component renders a centered container with padding and max-width of 600px using inline style objects
Component includes an h1 heading with text "Contact Us"
Component includes a paragraph with introductory text
Component displays contact details (Email, Phone, Address) with marginTop and lineHeight styles
Component contains a placeholder section for a future contact form
All style definitions are inline JavaScript style objects
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
